Marshadow

Fighting Ghost

Alola · Generation 7 · Mythical Pokémon

Marshadow is a Fighting/Ghost-type Gloomdweller Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 22.2 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 600.
